title: agents-compose configuration
description: Configuration for composing Markdown sources into AGENTS.md.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema reference used by editors.

output.description: Output path relative to the configuration file.

sources.description: Source paths or glob patterns, expanded in declaration order.

exclude.description: Glob patterns removed after source expansion.

stripFrontmatter.description: Remove a leading frontmatter block from each source.

sourceComments.description: Add a source path comment before each source.
